book.execution: first weekly close strictly after the decision

forward_evidence: none. No strategy in this project has been promoted or traded.
known_weaknesses: Step 279: 66.8% of positions survive each quarterly rebalance and only 6.39 of its 20 names are independent, giving 8.6 effective bets a year.
De-persisting the book raised Sharpe 0.878 to 1.007 at paired-bootstrap p=0.632, which is noise, not an improvement.
mutation_policy: Any change to the signal, universe, breadth, weighting, cadence, cost model or data treatment creates a new version and restarts any clock it carries.
one_line: The twenty highest cash-conversion issuers in the survivorship-aware SEC panel, equally weighted, rebalanced quarterly.
universe: Point-in-time tradable members of the quarterly SEC filer roster
what_this_file_is: A description of what the strategy IS, written so it can be rebuilt without reading the script that happened to produce it. A rebuild script says what was run; this says what the thing is. Step 278 found four of six dashboard strategies had neither.
